---
pagetitle: "Radyssey"
description: "Free interactive radiology lessons for residents. One real image per lesson, overlays you can move, and a self-test."
listing:
  id: lessons
  contents: lessons.yml
  feed: true
  sort: "date desc"
  type: grid
  grid-columns: 3
  fields: [image, date, title, description]
  date-format: "D MMM YYYY"
  categories: false
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: false
  image-height: 200px
page-layout: full
# The home page has no maths; skip the MathJax CDN script.
html-math-method: plain
---

```{=html}
<div class="rv-wrap">
<section class="rv-hero">
  <div>
    <p class="rv-h1" role="heading" aria-level="1">Don't read about it. <em>Drag it.</em></p>
    <p class="lede">Every Radyssey lesson is a real image you can work on. Try it here: drag the <span class="c-roof">bony rim</span> and watch the angle it makes with the <span class="c-base">baseline</span> decide the hip type.</p>
    <a class="md-btn filled" href="lessons/graf-hip-ultrasound/"><svg viewBox="0 -960 960 960" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M320-200v-560l440 280-440 280Z"/></svg>Start the Graf lesson</a>
    <p class="small">Free · works on your phone · no sign-up</p>
  </div>
  <div class="toy">
    <svg id="toy" viewBox="0 0 640 400" role="img" aria-label="Schematic infant hip. Drag the bony rim to change angle alpha and see the Graf type.">
      <defs><pattern id="sp" width="8" height="8" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><circle cx="1" cy="1" r=".9" fill="var(--md-outline-variant)"/></pattern></defs>
      <rect width="640" height="400" rx="12" fill="url(#sp)"/>
      <text x="16" y="26" font-family="Roboto Flex" font-weight="500" font-size="12" letter-spacing=".5" fill="var(--md-on-surface-variant)">LATERAL · SKIN</text>
      <text x="16" y="388" font-family="Roboto Flex" font-weight="500" font-size="12" letter-spacing=".5" fill="var(--md-on-surface-variant)">MEDIAL · DEEP</text>
      <path id="cartF" fill="var(--md-cart)" opacity=".14"/>
      <circle id="head" r="72" fill="var(--md-surface-container-high)" stroke="var(--md-outline)" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 6"/>
      <text id="headT" font-family="Roboto Flex" font-size="14" fill="var(--md-on-surface-variant)" text-anchor="middle">femoral head</text>
      <path id="bone" fill="none" stroke="var(--md-on-surface)" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity=".8"/>
      <line y1="200" y2="200" x1="0" x2="640" stroke="var(--md-base)" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="10 7"/>
      <line id="roofL" stroke="var(--md-roof)" stroke-width="3"/>
      <line id="cartL" stroke="var(--md-cart)" stroke-width="2.5"/>
      <path id="arc" fill="color-mix(in srgb, var(--md-roof) 16%, transparent)" stroke="var(--md-roof)" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text id="arcT" font-family="Roboto Flex" font-style="italic" font-size="22" fill="var(--md-roof)">α</text>
      <g class="handle" id="handle"><circle id="hRing" class="ring" r="12" fill="none" stroke="var(--md-roof)" stroke-width="2"/><circle id="hDot" r="12" fill="var(--md-roof)" stroke="var(--md-surface-container-lowest)" stroke-width="3"/><circle id="hHit" r="30" fill="transparent"/></g>
    </svg>
    <div class="bar">
      <span class="read">α = <b id="aVal">60°</b></span>
      <span class="badge" id="badge">Type I · mature</span>
      <button class="md-btn outlined reset" id="reset"><svg viewBox="0 -960 960 960" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M480-160q-134 0-227-93t-93-227q0-134 93-227t227-93q69 0 132 28.5T720-690v-110h80v280H520v-80h168q-32-56-87.5-88T480-720q-100 0-170 70t-70 170q0 100 70 170t170 70q77 0 139-44t87-116h84q-28 106-114 173t-196 67Z"/></svg>Reset</button>
    </div>
    <p class="caption">A schematic hip, not a real scan. It types by α alone; the full lesson adds β and the baby's age.</p>
  </div>
</section>
<h2 class="rv-sec">Lessons</h2>
<p class="rv-sec-sub">Each lesson is one real image: work through the steps, move the overlays, then test yourself.</p>
```
